title: Rick E Possible NDE 7227
content: It seemed as though the planet kept moving, but I didn't. I traveled through the solar system, the galaxy, and the universe seeing nebul' along the way. I finally arrived at a place where there was a cylinder made of rotating lights, not unlike a tunnel. As I got closer, beings appeared to be angel-like, and I felt as if I might know them. The most important thing to me overall was the feeling of being free. No fear. Total awe. It was the best I ever felt in my existence.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain. Drug or medication overdose. Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Tunnel | Presence of deceased persons | Unearthly light | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: No I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal
elements.At what time during the experience were: All. There wasn't anything interfering such as multiple senses. It was basically all visual and emotional.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual Since I traveled through the universe in a matter of minutes, I guess I was going fast.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I don't recall any auditory experience.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain I approached the tunnel of lights but didn't go through it.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I thought I knew them but was pulled back to this world before I could be sure.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I guess outer space is unearthly.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience I was somewhat religious at the time. I suppose this could have influenced my experience.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes The tunnel lights would seem to have been angels so yea.
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: experience? God probably exists Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes It seemed that life was just a testing ground and that I had passed.
elements.Do you believe in an afterlife after you: An afterlife definitely exists Yes I felt death was just the beginning.
elements.Were you fearful living your life prior: Slightly fearful in living my earthly life
elements.Were you fearful living your life after: Not fearful in living my earthly life
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: Slight changes in my life slight changes
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? No No After the NDE
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Right away. I couldn't say how someone else was affected by my story.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was probably real It seemed as real as every day.
